serviceArea.description: This professional travels to their clients: there is no waiting room. Book a slot instead.

error.title: Could not load the queue

join.title: Join the queue
join.presenceHint: You need to be at the shop to join: the QR displayed there and your position confirm it.
join.scanHint: Point at the QR code displayed in the shop.
join.nameHint: Shown at the counter, with only your last-name initial.
join.nameRequired: Enter your first name to join the queue.
join.emailHint: To find your spot from any device — a one-time code, no password.
join.submit: Join — your position will be checked
join.tokenExplainer: The QR displayed in the shop proves you are there. Your position is only requested at that moment.

issue.geo-denied: Without your position we cannot confirm you are at the shop. Allow location access and try again.
issue.geo-unavailable: Your position could not be determined. Move near a window and try again.
issue.scan-failed: That QR code is not this shop's. Scan the one displayed on site.
issue.otp-failed: That code is invalid or has expired. Check the latest email you received.
issue.email-send-failed: The email could not be sent. Check the address, or continue without an account.

refusal.service_area_has_no_queue: This professional travels to their clients: there is no live queue. Book a slot instead.
refusal.invalid_check_in_token: This QR code is no longer valid. Scan the one displayed in the shop.
refusal.location_not_geolocated: This shop has not published its position yet, so the queue cannot admit anyone. Let the counter know.
refusal.position_required: Your position is required to join: you need to be at the shop. Allow location access and try again.
refusal.too_far: You are too far from the shop to join its queue. Get closer and try again on site.
refusal.queue_closed: The queue is not taking anyone right now. Ask at the counter or come back later.
refusal.queue_full: The queue is full. Come back a little later, or book a slot.
refusal.already_in_queue: You are already in a queue. Finish or leave it before joining another.
